label: Strong English essay
title: The Day I Learned to Be Patient
content:
Last spring, my grandfather taught me how to plant a vegetable garden. At first, I thought it would be boring, because nothing seemed to happen for days after we put the seeds into the soil.

Every morning I ran outside, hoping to see something green, and every morning I came back disappointed. My grandfather only smiled and told me that good things grow slowly. He showed me how to water the beds gently and how to pull out weeds without hurting the young roots.

After two weeks, tiny shoots finally appeared. I was so excited that I counted them twice. By the end of summer, we picked tomatoes, beans and cucumbers, and my mother cooked a delicious soup with them.

That garden taught me more than how to grow vegetables. It taught me that patience is not just waiting; it is caring for something every day, even when you cannot see any results yet.

label: Average English essay
title: My Favourite Sport
content:
My favourite sport is basketball. I play it with my friends every Saturday at the court near my house. Basketball is fun because you need to work as a team and run a lot.

I am not very tall but I am fast, so I usually pass the ball to my friends. Sometimes we win and sometimes we lose, but we always have a good time. After the game we buy drinks and talk about the game.

I think everyone should play a sport because it keeps you healthy and you can make new friends.

label: Chinese essay
title: 我的妈妈
content:
我的妈妈是一位老师。她每天很早就起床，给我们做早饭，然后去学校上课。

妈妈对学生很耐心，对我也很温柔。有一次我考试没考好，心里很难过。妈妈没有批评我，而是陪我一起找出错误，告诉我下次要更认真。

晚上，妈妈还要改作业，常常忙到很晚。我觉得妈妈非常辛苦。我长大以后，也想像妈妈一样，做一个对别人有帮助的人。
